constraints: The schema contract is defined by `to-do.schema.json` as a JSON Schema draft 2020-12 object schema titled `Codex RALF Todo`.
The root object must reject unknown keys because `additionalProperties` is `false` and must include `schema_version`, `source_files`, and `tasks`.
`schema_version` must equal integer `1`; `source_files` items must be strings; `project` may appear only as an object with optional `name` and `root` string fields.
Each task object must reject unknown keys, require `id`, `title`, `priority`, and `status`, and constrain `priority` to 1..5 and `status` to `todo|doing|blocked|done`.
Optional task metadata is limited to the typed fields defined in the schema, including `date-time` formatted `created_at` and `updated_at` strings.
goal: Capture the current todo JSON Schema contract so another agent can recreate `to-do.schema.json` and compatible task records.
